
                    ╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
                    ║  PCBoard 15.4 Revival — Upgrade Guide║
                    ╚══════════════════════════════════════╝


    UPGRADING FROM PCBoard 15.2 or 15.3
    ════════════════════════════════════

    PCBoard 15.4 Revival is a drop-in upgrade for existing 15.2 and
    15.3 installations. Your data files, message bases, user files,
    conferences, and DOOR configurations are fully compatible.


    BEFORE YOU BEGIN
    ────────────────

    1. BACK UP EVERYTHING.

       Copy your entire PCBoard directory to a safe location.
       At minimum, back up these files:

           PCBOARD.DAT        System configuration
           USERS               User database
           USERS.INF           Extended user info
           CNAMES.@@@          Conference names
           DLPATH.LST          Download paths
           Your message base directories
           Your PPE scripts directory

    2. Note your current version number.
       Run PCBOARD /V to display it.

    3. If you are running any TSR programs (FOSSIL drivers, network
       redirectors), note their configuration. pcbis.exe may replace
       some of them.


    UPGRADE PROCEDURE
    ─────────────────

    Step 1: Stop PCBoard
        Ensure no callers are online. Bring down all nodes.
        If running under a front-end mailer, exit that too.

    Step 2: Replace Executables
        From Disk 2, extract PCB154.ZIP over your existing PCBoard
        directory. This replaces the following files:

            PCBOARDM.EXE     (was ~900K, now ~974K)
            PCBOARD.EXE
            LOCAL.EXE
            PCBSETUP.EXE
            PCBSM.EXE
            PPLC.EXE
            MKPCBTXT.EXE
            UUIN.EXE
            UUOUT.EXE
            UUUTIL.EXE
            UUXFER.EXE

        For OS/2: replace PCBOARD2.EXE separately.

    Step 3: Run PCBSETUP
        Start PCBSETUP and review your configuration. New options
        will appear with sensible defaults. Key changes:

        •  Internet Services section (for pcbis.exe)
        •  Enhanced security options
        •  New PPL function permissions

    Step 4: Regenerate Text Files
        Run MKPCBTXT to update your PCBTEXT file with new prompts
        added in 15.4. Your customized prompts are preserved —
        only new entries are added.

    Step 5: Recompile PPE Scripts (Optional)
        If you have PPL scripts that use advanced features, recompile
        them with the included PPLC 3.40. Existing .PPE files from
        15.2/15.3 will continue to work without recompilation.

    Step 6: Install Internet Services (Optional)
        If you want telnet/internet access:

        a. Copy PCBIS.EXE and PCBIS.CFG from Disk 4
        b. Edit PCBIS.CFG:
           - Set your telnet port (default 2323)
           - Set node range (must match PCBOARD.DAT node count)
           - Configure BinkP address if using FidoNet
           - Set SMTP relay for validation emails
        c. Run PCBIS.EXE
        d. Your FOSSIL driver is no longer needed for telnet nodes

    Step 7: Test
        Run LOCAL.EXE to verify the BBS works in local mode.
        If using pcbis, telnet to your board and verify login.
        Check that Who's Online and Last Callers display correctly.


    WHAT CHANGES
    ────────────

    Files that are REPLACED (back up first):
        All .EXE files listed above

    Files that are UPDATED (new entries added, existing preserved):
        PCBTEXT            New prompts appended
        PCBOARD.DAT        New configuration fields (defaults applied)

    Files that are NOT TOUCHED:
        USERS              Your user database
        USERS.INF           Extended user data
        CNAMES.@@@          Conference configuration
        DLPATH.LST          File area paths
        All message bases
        All DOOR configurations
        All PPE scripts


    ROLLING BACK
    ────────────

    If you need to revert to 15.3:

    1. Stop PCBoard and pcbis
    2. Restore your backed-up .EXE files
    3. Your data files are untouched — no data migration needed
    4. New entries in PCBTEXT will be ignored by 15.3


    UPGRADING FROM 14.x OR EARLIER
    ──────────────────────────────

    Upgrade to 15.2 first using the standard 15.2 upgrade procedure,
    then follow the 15.3→15.4 instructions above. Direct upgrades
    from 14.x to 15.4 are not supported.


    NOTES FOR MODEM-BASED SYSTEMS
    ─────────────────────────────

    If you are still running PCBoard with modems and FOSSIL drivers,
    15.4 Revival works exactly like 15.3 — no changes needed. The
    pcbis.exe Internet Services daemon is optional.

    If you want to ADD internet access alongside your modem lines:
    •  Dedicate some nodes to pcbis (telnet) and keep others on modems
    •  pcbis and modem nodes share the same user database and messages
    •  Callers on both modem and telnet appear in Who's Online together

    If you want to REPLACE modems entirely:
    •  Remove your FOSSIL driver
    •  Configure all nodes for pcbis
    •  Your phone line is now free


    GETTING HELP
    ────────────

    Source code and issue tracker:
        https://github.com/verta1878/pcbrevival
